title: Settings

capturePolicy.title: Capture policy
capturePolicy.desc: Whether {{members}} can change capture settings on their own device.

screenshotInterval.title: Screenshot interval
screenshotInterval.desc: How often each {{member}}'s screen is captured.

idleThreshold.title: Idle threshold
idleThreshold.desc: No input for this long pauses active-time counting.

screenshotMode.title: Screenshot mode
screenshotMode.privacyDesc: Only the active window is captured — never the whole screen. No screenshot is taken while apps on the skip list are in front (prefilled with well-known chat, password and banking apps).
screenshotMode.normalDesc: Every screen is captured in full.

skipApps.title: Skip apps
skipApps.desc: No screenshot is taken while any of these apps is in front. Matching is forgiving: "Zalo" also covers "Zalo PC".

retention.title: Screenshot retention
retention.desc: How long the backend keeps uploaded screenshots for {{name}}. "Never" keeps them indefinitely.

cleanup.title: Manual cleanup
cleanup.desc: Delete old screenshots to free up space.
cleanup.warning: Files and records older than {{days}} days are permanently removed. This cannot be undone.

audit.title: Administrative actions
audit.desc: Recent account and device changes for this organization. Passwords, tokens and screenshot contents are never stored here.
audit.loadFailed: Could not load the audit log.
audit.empty: No administrative actions have been recorded yet.

v1.emptyDescription: Administrative changes will appear here as they happen.

roleDenied: Your role can view reports, but organization settings require owner or admin access.

v1.subtitle: Organization preferences for {{name}}
v1.noBusinessDescription: Create or select an organization before configuring monitoring.

organization.description: Organization identity and your access level.
organization.name: Organization name

monitoring.description: Control how workstation activity and idle time are managed.

screenshots.description: Configure screenshot capture frequency and privacy exclusions.

storage.description: Retention and manual cleanup of uploaded screenshot data.
